translations.web: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;
translations.bsb: Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;
translations.kjv: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
translations.asv: And not only so, but we also rejoice in our tribulations: knowing that tribulation worketh stedfastness;
